say:1:1222703001:1.text: Are you looking for something? Do you need any help?
say:1:1222703001:1.source_cn: 你在找什么呀？需要帮忙吗？

say:2:1222703002:1.text: Oh, wonderful! Who would've thought I'd run into such kind-hearted folks in the middle of nowhere?
say:2:1222703002:1.source_cn: 噢，太好了！没想到这么偏僻的地界还能遇到好心人！

say:3:1222703003:1.text: You see, I didn't notice there was a hole in my backpack, and a bunch of gold fell out! I'm trying to find them now.
say:3:1222703003:1.source_cn: 你们瞧瞧，我这包背了太久，一不注意竟然破了个洞，包里的...

say:4:1222703004:1.text: *Sigh* It took me months to save up for all that gold... Without it, there's no way I can catch any <style="highlight">golden peacocks</style>.
say:4:1222703004:1.source_cn: 唉，这些金币可是我攒了大半年的……要是找不回来，我今天...

choice_prompt:5:1222703004.text: *Sigh* It took me months to save up for all that gold... Without it, there's no way I can catch any <style="highlight">golden peacocks</style>.
choice_prompt:5:1222703004.source_cn: 唉，这些金币可是我攒了大半年的……要是找不回来，我今天铁定钓不上<style=highlight>黄金孔雀</style>。

say:6:1222703005:1.text: ... You've never heard of the golden peacocks? They're as famous as the damedangler species.
say:6:1222703005:1.source_cn: ……你们连黄金孔雀都不知道？那可是能和冥湾美人齐名的珍...

say:7:1222703007:1.text: No, in fact, they're even rarer than damedanglers. They're known as the king of fish!
say:7:1222703007:1.source_cn: 不！应该说，它是比冥湾美人更稀奇的、传说中的鱼王！

say:9:1222703008:1.text: Is that a bit of a stretch...?

say:10:1222703009:1.text: Hahaha... The truth will emerge only once we've caught one.
say:10:1222703009:1.source_cn: 哈哈，事实如何，总得先钓上来才能一探究竟。

say:11:1222703010:1.text: According to those veteran fishermen, Rustport is the only place with golden peacocks across the entire Esperia, and they are <style="highlight">most likely to appear at dusk and during the night</style>.
say:11:1222703010:1.source_cn: 那些老渔夫们说，整个伊索米亚大陆上只有锈锚港这片水域里...

say:12:1222703011:1.text: The most amazing thing is that it's rumored to eat only gold, making it look like pure gold itself! It's worth a king's ransom!
say:12:1222703011:1.source_cn: 最稀奇的是，据说它只吃金子，所以看起来也像是纯金打造的...

say:13:1222703012:1.text: That sounds really familiar... Haven't we come across this before?
say:13:1222703012:1.source_cn: 好熟悉的说法，我们是不是在哪里听说过……

say:14:1222703013:1.text: Ah! It's Rowan's duck, Bradduck, right? The legendary duck that eats gold and lays golden eggs!
say:14:1222703013:1.source_cn: 啊！是罗万的鸭子，布拉达克一世吧？传说中会吃金币产金蛋...

say:18:1222703015:1.text:
What?! You've seen a live Aix?!
I need to let my colleagues know later. They study birds.
say:18:1222703015:1.source_cn: ……什么，你们见过活的姝鸯？！\n回头我得转告我那个研...

choice_prompt:19:1222703015.text:
What?! You've seen a live Aix?!
I need to let my colleagues know later. They study birds.
choice_prompt:19:1222703015.source_cn: ……什么，你们见过活的姝鸯？！\n回头我得转告我那个研究鸟类的同事。

say:20:1222703016:1.text: ... This is for research! Research, I tell you!

say:21:1222703017:1.text: Forgive me if I sound boastful, but I'd say I'm the top fish expert at the Evergreen Conservatory.
say:21:1222703017:1.source_cn: 不是我自夸，在研究鱼类这方面，要是我自称第二，冬青学会...

say:22:1222703019:1.text: Oh, we can talk about this later. Please help me find the gold coins that fell!
say:22:1222703019:1.source_cn: 哎哟，没空聊这些了。快帮我找找掉出去的金币吧！

say:23:1222703020:1.text: Each extra coin increases the odds of catching a golden peacock!
say:23:1222703020:1.source_cn: 多一枚金币，就多一分钓上黄金孔雀的可能性！！

choice:19:0:1.text: Are you fishing to make money?
choice:19:0:1.male: Are you fishing to make money?
choice:19:0:1.female: Are you fishing to make money?

say:25:1222703018:1.text: Well... it's all for academic research.
say:25:1222703018:1.source_cn: 没办法，为了学术研究嘛。

choice:19:1:2.text: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 没钓到岂不是得不偿失？
choice:19:1:2.male: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.
choice:19:1:2.female: It'd be a loss if you didn't catch anything.

say:26:1222703006:1.text: Yes, using gold coins as bait is the only way to catch golden peacocks. They're a rare species of fish and as famous as the damedangler.
say:26:1222703006:1.source_cn: 是啊，用金币当诱饵才有可能钓上黄金孔雀。它可是能和冥湾...
